glossary.definition: A diagram stored as a small JSON document (boxes, arrows, steps) instead of drawn art, so it can be edited, reviewed, exported and imported.
Boxes for the parties and arrows for the calls between them, in order. Each arrow is one message, so walking the arrows tells the story.
Simulate highlights one arrow at a time, with Pause, Prev, Next and a speed control, so a presenter can pace the explanation.

cards.label: Edit and export
cards.description: Add boxes and arrows, rename them, save a copy and export the diagram as JSON to share or re-import.

cards.label: Diagram studio
cards.description: Pick a flow diagram, drag the boxes, Simulate the arrows, change the speed, Reset, then save or export it.

diagrams.label: MCP tool call held for approval
